title: Slot-fit check: current 3,819,448 B apollo-main and 246,040 B EM9305 source package both fit stock partitions; hard apollo install end is 0x007FE000, 137,288 B of headroom
scope: Host arithmetic against the stock memory map, packager checks, SBL STATUS, and the already-linked opencfw-otap-disarm / 12 Nov EM9305 source-candidate images. No flash. No commit.

verdict.brick_risk_from_current_sizes: No: the current 3.82 MB app ends at 0x007DC7B8, 137,288 bytes before the bootloader-owned OTA flag page at 0x007FE000. Do not treat the HLE SBL maxStorage (3,964,928 B) as the install limit; it extends past 0x007FE000.

sbl_rom_reserved.note: Must not be overwritten. App does not start until 0x00438000.

ota_preamble_position.note: File header only; DFU programmer skips it and programs the raw image at 0x00438000. Not part of the installed app span.

app_slot_hard_end.source: MAIN_UPDATE_FLAG in g2/tools/open_cfw.py; g2-apollo-main.ld ASSERT; documented bootloader-owned update flag (16 B) at 0x007FE000. wrap_main_image and validate_apollo_main reject any image whose run_base+size exceeds this.

bond_records.note: After the flag page; current image does not reach it.

limits.sbl_22bit_note: g2_sbl_image.py: standard-image size is 22 bits (control & 0x3FFFFF), including the 32-byte header. OpenCFW wrapped size would be 3,819,480, well under 4,194,303. wrap_main_image also has a 24-bit check (0x00FFFFFF).

hle_sbl_maxStorage.sim: Renode G2Apollo510_SblWired default MaxStorage is 0x003C8000 (exactly the linker MRAM LENGTH 0x438000..0x800000). The 22 Nov HLE run reported 3,964,928. Both extend past 0x007FE000 (0x438000+0x3C8000=0x800000). Do not use this as the install cap.

ota_staging.mram: Single-slot. Ordinary G2 application OTA has no proven rollback (open_cfw.py). DFU writes the raw image into the same 0x00438000..0x007FE000 slot after stripping the 32-byte preamble.
ota_staging.nor: External MX25U25643G 32 MiB: [0x00000000, 0x01400000) 20 MiB is 'not characterised (resources, staged images, other)' — large enough for a 3.82 MB staged file if that is where the download lives, but the location is unverified. littlefs and FlashDB start at 0x01400000 and are outside MRAM.

non_overlap.kvdb_migration_section: KEEP'd in the app .text; it is code/data inside the image, not a NOR KV overlap.

gc_probe_still_fits.note: The /tmp --gc-sections probe from item (b) is smaller and also fits. It was not adopted as the official image in (b).

em9305.note: 246,040 is the host-side record container, not a flat 246 KB load at 0x00300000. Records are placed at their target addresses with gaps preserved.

nvm.source: EM9305 DS Table 5-1 and g2-em9305.ld MEMORY NVM; overflow fails the link by region size.

em9305.datasheet_app_window: 0x00302400..0x00380000; stock package has no FOTA updater record (wave13-loadable-images.md). Growing the app from 0x00335BC8 to 0x0033DFE4 stays inside that window.
